permission.bluetooth: Coach Poulpy connects to your treadmill to show and record your speed, distance and heart rate.

home.inProgress: Your session is waiting where you left it.
home.restBody: Enjoy the rest, or pick a workout from your library if you feel like moving.
home.firstBody: Make your first workout in the library, then plan it for a day.
home.somethingElse: Something else? Pick from your library
home.discardBody: It won’t show in your history or your totals. This can’t be undone.

library.nothingHint: Try another word, or look in the exercises to build one.
library.emptyBody: Build one once, then plan it for any day or keep it here for later.

workout.plannedDays: {days, plural, one {Planned on # day} other {Planned on # days}}

plan.title: Plan {name}
plan.hint: Tap the days to train it. Tap again to take one off.

exercises.nothingHint: Try one word, a muscle like “glutes”, or something you own like “dumbbell”.
exercises.noFitHint: Try another muscle, or tick more of what you have.
exercises.equipmentHint: Tick what you have to list the exercises that use it.
exercises.focusHint: What the exercise is for. Tick several to widen the list.
exercises.positionHint: How you are placed while you do it.
exercises.zonesHint: Tap the parts of the body you want to work. Left and right count together.
exercises.tagsHint: Other things worth knowing before you pick. Each one you tick narrows the list.

exercise.variationsHint: Easiest at the top, hardest at the bottom.

builder.name: Name
builder.tapToType: tap a value to type it
builder.valueInvalid: This can’t be read. Type a value like the quick picks below.
builder.addToRepeat: Add a step to this repeat
builder.formatSubtitle: You choose once: the format stays for this workout.
builder.circuitDescription: Rounds through several exercises, each done once per round. Fits HIIT, bodyweight circuits and runs.
builder.setsDescription: One exercise at a time: all its sets, then the next. Fits gym and strength training.
builder.addPartSubtitle: Parts run in order: warm-up, work, cool down.
builder.circuitHint: A circuit has no sets: the repeat around it sets the rounds.
builder.setsHint: Rest between sets shows from 2 sets. A walk or a run has no sets.

player.stopBody: What you did so far is kept.

history.emptyBody: Finish a workout or a treadmill session and it will show up here.
history.deleteBody: It leaves your history and stats. This can’t be undone.
history.activeDays: {days, plural, one {# active day · swipe for other months} other {# active days · swipe for other months}}
history.resting: No session that day. Poulpy was resting too.

live.emptyBody: Switch on your treadmill, pod or band. Poulpy connects to the ones you added as soon as they are nearby.
live.modeAuto: Auto: starts, pauses and stops with the treadmill
live.modeManual: Manual: you start and stop the recording
live.modeInfo: With the sync button on, Start waits for the belt to move. Pausing the treadmill pauses the recording, and Stop on the console finishes it. If the belt stays still or the treadmill disconnects for a while, you’re asked whether to finish. With it off, you start, pause and stop here.
live.stepWaitBody: The step starts when the belt moves
live.stepWaitTap: Start when you’re on the treadmill
live.finishStillBody: The belt stopped {stoppedMinutes, number} min ago. With no answer, Poulpy finishes the session in {finishMinutes, number} min, ending it at {endTime}.
live.finishStoppedBody: You stopped the treadmill. Start it again to carry on, even with another program. With no answer, Poulpy finishes the session in {finishMinutes, number} min, ending it at {endTime}.
live.finishLostBody: It disconnected {lostMinutes, number} min ago and Poulpy keeps trying. With no answer, the session finishes in {finishMinutes, number} min, ending at {endTime}, when it was last seen.
live.finishClosedBody: The app closed during your session, and Poulpy kept the first {endTime}. If you don’t answer, it ends there in {finishMinutes, number} min.
live.notificationChannelInfo: Shows while Live records a session, so it keeps going with the screen off or another app open.

settings.themeHint: System follows your phone’s light or dark mode.
settings.unitsHint: Metric: km, km/h, kg, cm. Imperial: mi, mph, lb, ft and in. Weight and height you logged are converted, never changed.
settings.languageNextLaunch: A new language shows the next time you open the app.
settings.aboutLine: Version {version} · data stays on this phone

devices.emptyBody: Add your treadmill, a foot pod or a heart rate band. Poulpy shows their numbers together while you run, and records the session.
devices.forgetBody: Poulpy stops connecting to it. You can add it again later.
devices.autoConnectHint: When the app opens and it is nearby
devices.sourcesHint: When two devices measure the same thing, pick the one to trust. Automatic prefers what is on your body: the pod over the treadmill, the band over the treadmill’s grips.
devices.scanHint: Treadmills, foot pods and heart rate bands. Wake your device up and stay close to it.
devices.addedHidden: Devices you already added are not listed here.
devices.permissionNeeded: Allow Bluetooth access so the app can find your devices.
devices.bluetoothOff: Bluetooth is off. Turn it on to connect to your devices.

kind.unknown: Unknown device, tried as a treadmill

import.title: Add this workout?
import.note: It is added as a copy in your library. Nothing you already have changes.
import.nothingAdded: Nothing was added to your library.

shareSession.title: Share this session
shareSession.fitNote: Save it, then import it on the Garmin Connect or Strava website
shareSession.imageNote: A card with your numbers to send or post

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: Everything is optional and stays on this phone
profile.name: What should Poulpy call you?
profile.pronounsNote: Used for French wording and Poulpy’s lines. A custom entry is repeated as written; French wording that needs a gender stays neutral.
profile.customPronouns: Your pronouns, in your own words
profile.sexNote: Only used for estimates such as calories and heart rate zones. Skip it and Poulpy uses a neutral average.
profile.sexWhy: Why we ask: calorie and heart rate estimates differ a little with it. It is never shown to anyone, and you can leave it out.
profile.sexNotGender: This is not about your gender, and Poulpy never asks about it. Your pronouns are set separately.
profile.restingHrHint: Between 30 and 120. Used for heart rate zones.
profile.goalsNote: Pick as many as you like. Poulpy suggests workouts for all of them.
profile.pronounsSheetNote: Used for French wording and Poulpy’s lines.
profile.experienceNote: Used for starting loads and plan suggestions. You can change it any time.
profile.figureNote: Only the drawing used for pain and muscles. It is separate from the line above and is never used for estimates.
profile.figureWhy: The figure Poulpy draws when you say where it hurts or which muscles a workout uses. It is only a drawing and changes nothing else.
profile.painNote: Poulpy stays on the blue side until then. With nothing set, this row says None.
profile.painWhy: Poulpy stays on the blue side and never asks you to catch up. Nothing leaves this phone.
profile.painHint: Tap an area on the figure, and switch between front and back. Each side lights on its own, so left and right are never mixed up.
profile.painDurationClearedSub: Rehab with no end date. Clear it here when you are back
profile.painAgain: Still hurting when the time is up? Set it again, it only takes a tap.

body.weightStored: Type it, or nudge it with − and +. Stored in kilograms, shown in your units.
body.heightStored: Type it, or nudge it with − and +. Stored in centimetres, shown in your units.
body.heightNote: Height changes slowly: a measure every few months is plenty.
body.chartEmpty: Log an entry to see your chart.
body.emptyWeightBody: Log it once to see your chart. It stays on this phone, and only you see it.
body.emptyHeightBody: Log it once to see your chart. A measure every few months is plenty.

appIcon.description: Pick Poulpy’s face for your home screen. This doesn’t change Poulpy’s mood in the app.
appIcon.tapNote: Tap an icon to apply it and close this sheet.
appIcon.iosNote: On iOS, your phone shows a system alert after the icon changes.

account.guestRow: Sign in or create an account
account.guestRowHint: Back up your training and use it on other phones.
account.title: Account
account.signUpIntro: Back up your training and pick it up on any phone. The app keeps working without a connection.
account.consent: I agree that Coach Poulpy keeps my health data (sessions, measurements, pain) to sync it between my phones.
account.errorEmail: That address doesn’t look right. It should look like name@example.com.
account.errorConsent: Tick the box to create an account. Without it, nothing leaves this phone.
account.errorOffline: No connection. Try again when you’re online; the app keeps working as a guest.
account.consentSheetIntro: Once your email is confirmed, your phone sends this to Coach Poulpy’s server so you can find it on other phones:
account.consentItemBody: Your profile and body measurements, including pain or rehab
account.consentStays: Theme, app icon and paired devices stay on each phone.
account.consentWhy: Why: to back up and sync. Nothing is shared with anyone, and you can delete the account and everything in it whenever you like.
account.consentBefore: Until you confirm your email, nothing leaves this phone.
account.checkEmailBody: If {email} can get an account, a link is on its way. Open it on this phone to finish. It works for 24 hours.
account.checkEmailGuest: Until then, your training stays on this phone and the app works as usual.
account.checkEmailPoulpy: Take your time. I’ll wait by the mailbox.
account.confirmedPoulpy: Lifting your training into the cloud. Eight tentacles, no waiting.
account.uploadOffline: It carries on when you’re back online.
account.mergeBody: Your workouts and sessions on this phone are joining your account. Nothing is replaced, and both edits are kept.
account.signInIntro: Use the account you made on another phone. What is on this phone joins your account; nothing is replaced.
account.errorSignIn: Wrong email or password. Check both and try again.
account.errorTooManyTries: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
account.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we’ll send a link to choose a new password.
account.forgotSentBody: If {email} has an account, a link to choose a new password is on its way.
account.forgotSentNote: Choosing a new password signs every phone out.
account.resetIntro: Every phone signed in to this account will be signed out.
account.linkExpiredBody: It may have been used already, or it expired after 24 hours. Sign up again with the same address and we’ll send a new one.
account.stateNotSyncingHint: This phone stays a guest until you confirm your email.
account.pendingBody: We sent a link to {email}. Until you open it, nothing leaves this phone.
account.followsBody: Workouts, plans and sessions, your profile and body log, units and language. Theme, app icon and paired devices stay on each phone.
account.exportHint: JSON, and your sessions as FIT files
account.signOutBody: Everything is sent already. This phone goes back to an empty guest; your workouts and sessions stay in your account.
account.unsentBody: They are waiting for a connection. If you sign out now, they never reach your account and are gone from this phone.
account.deleteBody: This deletes everything stored in your account, right away and for good. Every phone signed in goes back to a guest and keeps its own copy. Backups age out within 30 days.
account.errorDeletePassword: That password isn’t right. Nothing was deleted.
